items.title: Operation “Trolling Stone”: Russia-linked influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreported operation we dubbed "Trolling Stone", using AI to generate comments about an alleged Russian cult leader’s arrest in Argentina.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布报告称封禁了名为“Trolling Stone”的俄罗斯相关账号，该组织利用AI生成虚假评论以进行舆论影响。此事件体现了AI在内容生成与社会工程学攻击中的潜在风险，强调了模型厂商在安全合规与滥用监测方面的责任。

items.title: Operation “Fish Food”: Russia-origin content farm activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to the Rybar network, some of which likely originated in Russia, that used AI to support multilingual influence activity across websites and social platforms.

items.title: Operation “No Bell”: Coordinated criticism of the US and allies
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreported, likely Russia-origin operation we dubbed "No Bell", using AI to produce criticism of the US and its allies for audiences across Africa.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了名为“No Bell”的行动网络，该网络利用AI生成针对美国及其盟友的批评内容，主要针对非洲受众。这是AI被用于地缘政治影响力的典型案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: 记录了针对特定区域的AI舆论攻击行为，对理解AI安全边界有价值。

items.title: “Cyber Special Operations”: China-linked influence planning
items.summary: OpenAI banned an account linked to an individual associated with Chinese law enforcement, using AI to plan influence activity, harassment, and online operations.

items.title: Operation “Date Bait”: AI-enabled scam targeting loveseekers
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that very likely originated in Cambodia and used AI for scam outreach to Indonesian loveseekers, including translation and engagement.

items.title: Operation “False Witness”: Fake recovery service impersonating authorities
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that very likely originated in Cambodia and used AI to pose as recovery services, law firms, and authorities targeting people affected by fraud.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI近期封禁了一批源自柬埔寨的账户，这些账户利用大模型技术伪装成法律事务所、政府机构及欺诈恢复服务提供商，针对受害者进行二次诈骗。该行动揭示了恶意行为者如何通过AI自动化生成欺诈内容，并利用其进行社会工程学攻击。OpenAI通过此次行动展示了其在识别和打击滥用模型进行非法活动方面的治理能力，强调了在AI普及背景下，针对此类欺诈行为的监测与防御机制的重要性。

items.title: Silver lining playbook: Likely China-origin activity targeting US persons
items.summary: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to research US persons, locations, and social-engineering tactics.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布报告称，已封禁一批源自中国的账户，这些账户利用大模型技术对美国境内人员、地理位置及社会工程学策略进行研究与搜集。该活动显示了恶意行为者正尝试将AI集成到情报搜集和目标定位流程中，以提高攻击的针对性和效率。此次披露不仅揭示了当前大模型在网络安全领域的潜在滥用趋势，也体现了模型厂商在应对跨国网络威胁、维护平台安全生态方面的持续投入与监管力度。
